experiments.scope: The claimed program (proof Sections 2-3) per organizer trial: one batch of 256 lanes of pairs from the standard IV under a hard operation budget that halts generation before it is passed; per kept lane the junction recognition (schedule rebuild and steps 23..26 of both members) is performed and counted in ops_used; per lane the full 40-word schedule control and the sliced-vs-word control; J26 landing hits at 8, 16, 24 and 32 bits and the best match; then each kept pair with its J26 difference set to the target on its real state is run to step 40 (tail), with the bit-30 negative control.
experiments.hypothesis: All kept lanes pass both controls; kept lanes per batch are at least 192 of 256 (the ledger floor; measured mean 0.846); landing at k bits occurs at rate 2^-k for k = 8, 16, 24, 32 and the per-trial landing_k8 counts are Poisson-dispersed across trials (premises P1, P3); ops_used / kept is at most the per-kept-pair word-operation count in the ledger; every pair at the target collides after step 40 (premise P2) and the negative control never does; no full collision is expected at organizer scale.
